languages_frameworks: falkordb==1.8.0 client (compose pins server image falkordb/falkordb:6.0.2)

implemented_capabilities.capability: Pinned-commit repository snapshot acquisition with archive hardening
implemented_capabilities.notes: git ls-remote to resolve an exact 40-char SHA, then codeload tarball; enforces compressed/expanded byte caps, file-count caps, rejects absolute/parent paths and symlinks/hardlinks, skips vendored/generated files, hashes each file (sha256), redirects limited to GitHub hosts.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Static Python code graph extraction (symbols, EXACT/NAME_ONLY/UNRESOLVED/EXTERNAL call resolution, imports, refs, module vars, test detection, fixtures)
implemented_capabilities.notes: AST-only analysis (no execution) with import-map resolution, class hierarchy lookup, constructor tracking and an explicit confidence tag on every call edge so gaps stay visible instead of being guessed.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Staging-then-publish immutable graph per snapshot with count validation
implemented_capabilities.notes: Batched parameterised UNWIND writes of File/Symbol/ModuleVar/Unresolved/External nodes and CALLS/REFS/IMPORTS edges into a staging graph; validate() compares graph counts with analyzer output; publish() uses GRAPH.COPY then deletes staging; SQLite registry marks BUILDING/READY/FAILED so readers never see half-built graphs; graph names embed analyzer and schema versions and a prune command drops superseded ones.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Bounded read-only query tools: issue-text to candidate symbols, callers, tests, constraint files
implemented_capabilities.notes: Deterministic tiered ranking (traceback frame > title > linked-PR changed files > dotted name > module var > bare name > param) with hop cap 3 and result caps; no arbitrary Cypher accepted from UI or models; the graph-hop expansions are real but candidate selection itself is lexical heuristics, not learned.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Evidence packet with citation re-validation and honest status/unknowns
implemented_capabilities.notes: Each cited line range is re-checked against stored snapshot text at the pinned SHA (excerpt_hash) and a mismatch fails the pack; statuses never say ready-to-claim; issue/PR evidence carries observed_at with a 15 minute cache; failed checks are labelled unverified rather than empty; markdown output is HTML-escaped.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Benchmark harness with frozen cases and oracle scoring
implemented_capabilities.notes: Evaluates whether packet candidates cover files the real fix changed (parent-commit snapshot, 12 frozen cases): reports 9/12 file hits and 6/12 file+symbol hits after iterations; results are reported honestly including misses.
Seven read-only MCP tools via FastMCP; loopback-only FastAPI viewer with per-start access token, CSRF token and autoescaped templates.

graph_models_and_cypher: Nodes: Snapshot {repo, sha, analyzer, schema}, File {path, hash}, Symbol {id, qualname, name, kind: module|class|function|method, line_start, line_end, is_test, params, bases}, ModuleVar, Unresolved {expr}, External {expr}. Edges: IN_SNAPSHOT, DEFINED_IN, CALLS {tag: EXACT|NAME_ONLY|UNRESOLVED|EXTERNAL, expr, line, derived}, REFS, IMPORTS {line}. Writes are UNWIND batches (500/2000) with parameters only; reads are bounded parameterised MATCH queries; indexes created on Symbol.qualname/id/name, File.path, ModuleVar.name; GRAPH.COPY for publish. Standard OpenCypher, no APOC/GDS. Compose pins FalkorDB 6.0.2 while Kairos targets 4.22, so index syntax and any 6.x-only behaviour should be verified.
algorithms: AST-based call/reference resolution with confidence tags (patchpath/analyze.py)
Tiered lexical candidate ranking with call-distance tie-break up to 2 hops (patchpath/tools_query.py:find_candidates)
Caller in-degree via OPTIONAL MATCH count(DISTINCT) (patchpath/tools_query.py:_caller_indegree)
Snapshot validation by count reconciliation then GRAPH.COPY publish (patchpath/graphstore.py)
Citation excerpt hash re-validation at pinned SHA (patchpath/packet.py)
backend_interfaces: CLI: python -m patchpath.cli ingest / pack / prune
FastAPI viewer (patchpath/viewer.py) on 127.0.0.1 with token + CSRF
MCP stdio server (patchpath/mcp_server.py), seven read-only tools
frontend_interfaces: Single inline Jinja2 HTML page in patchpath/viewer.py (no separate frontend)
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: No LLM agent in the pack path: deterministic query tools plus markdown/JSON packets in data/packets/. SQLite registry is the only state readers trust for which graph is READY. Snapshot graphs are immutable and versioned by analyzer/schema, so earlier evidence remains reproducible. MCP exposes the tools to external agents.
tests_present: tests/: 9 files, about 108 pytest tests (analyze 54, packet 13, audit 11, registry 8, bridge 6, security 5, acquire 4, ranking 4, prune 3) including hostile tar paths, prompt-injection README/docstrings, XSS in markdown, and citation validation; plus recorded benchmark runs 2026-10-15/16. Most tests are offline; graph-store paths need FalkorDB. Not executed by auditor.
security_findings: patchpath/acquire.py:85 - subprocess.run(['git','ls-remote',...]) with the repo string validated by regex (owner/name) and a minimal env (PATH only, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0); safe pattern, but ref is passed as an argument without a '--' separator (low risk)
patchpath/eval.py:16 - imports subprocess for the benchmark harness (evaluation only; it does not run repository code per the docstring)
patchpath/acquire.py:183-222 - tar extraction is done in memory with isfile()/path-safety/size caps; positive control, no extractall
patchpath/viewer.py:105-148 - loopback bind, per-run secrets token compared with compare_digest, cookie httponly+samesite=strict, CSRF on POST /pack; single-user by design
patchpath/tools_query.py - all Cypher parameterised; no f-string Cypher with user data (graphstore.py:create_indexes interpolates only fixed label/property constants)
No hard-coded secrets, eval/exec or pickle found; README states it never runs repository code
duplicates_or_overlaps: Code-dependency / call-graph extraction and caller traversal overlaps blast-radius and software dependency repos; the pinned-snapshot evidence pack overlaps provenance-focused audit tools.
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - immutable commit-pinned snapshots, analyzer/schema-versioned graphs with superseded ones pruned, observed_at timestamps with cache TTL, explicit unknowns/unverified labels and citation excerpt hashes re-validated against stored text provide staleness and provenance primitives, but there is no dependency invalidation cascade or approval gating.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: A tested stage-validate-publish (GRAPH.COPY) pattern with a registry pointer and versioned graph names that guarantees readers never see a half-built or superseded graph; together with packet.py's citation hash re-validation it is a reusable provenance-freshness primitive. analyze.py is a separate reusable Python AST call-graph extractor.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (client falkordb 1.8.0); git binary and GitHub network access only for acquisition

strategy_rationale: Self-contained Python package with a clear graph schema; best adopted as a Software Dependency Intelligence pack (code graph + issue evidence), lifting the staging/publish and citation re-validation patterns into shared code. Verify compatibility against FalkorDB 4.22 since the project pins 6.0.2.
